tweet.text:
Arc Hits 168,000 Wallets in First 24 Hours

Circle's Arc went public on September 16 and pulled 167.6K active wallets on day one – 12x the 13.9K from the day before, when the chain was still in private mainnet with ~100 institutional builders.

What sets this launch apart: gas is paid in USDC, and the validators are BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard and ICE rather than crypto node operators. Day-one access came via Binance Wallet, OKX, MetaMask and Kraken, with Aave, Morpho and Uniswap live from the start.

With no native token and dollar-denominated fees, the airdrop crowd has little reason to show up – so if the count holds through the week, it's real demand.

Inspired by 🔗 @randgroup
